title: Environmental Workshop: Collaboration Betters The World (CBTW APAC)
summary: Environmental Workshop: Collaboration Betters The World (CBTW APAC)

contentBlocks.value: Last Wednesday 18 Sep 2024, Let’s Do It Vietnam partnered with Collaboration Betters The World (CBTW APAC) to conduct a workshop focused on environmental awareness and sustainable living for CBTW APAC employees. The workshop covered topics such as greenhouse gas emissions, sustainable living, waste sorting, and more.
The participants eagerly engaged in interactive sessions, where they shared personal perspectives and solutions to everyday environmental challenges.

By the end of the workshop, CBTW APAC members were inspired to implement sustainable practices both at home and within their organization, so that the knowledge gained would translate into real-world impact.
Let’s Do It Vietnam and CBTW APAC’s partnership demonstrates that with a shared vision and joint community efforts, a more sustainable future is within reach.
